# jamfplatform_pro_lock_device (Action)

Locks one or more computers or mobile devices. Every targeted device gets the same `pin`, `message` and `phone_number`.

If a device already has this command waiting, for example because it is offline, Jamf Pro keeps that command and queues no other, so a changed PIN or message does not reach the device.

The action commands every targeted device in a single request. If Jamf Pro cannot match one device, the whole request fails, no device is commanded and the error does not say which device it was, so a large batch is harder to diagnose than several small ones. Jamf Pro documents no maximum batch size.

**Required Jamf permissions**

Jamf lists this under **Platform environment** scope. You choose an integration's scope when you create it in Jamf Account, and cannot change it afterwards. The provider names the scopes it accepts when you configure it, and for a few families that is wider than Jamf lists here. Grant the API integration the following permissions in Jamf Account — see [Getting started with the Platform API](https://developer.jamf.com/platform-api/reference/getting-started-with-platform-api). `Category` and `Permission` name the section and row of the permission picker; `Actions` are the boxes to tick within that row.

| Category | Permission | Actions | API capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| Device actions | Destructive device actions | Execute | `destructive-device-actions` |
| Inventory | Devices | Read | `devices` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "lock_pin" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

action "jamfplatform_pro_lock_device" "lock" {
  config {
    serial_numbers = ["C02XXXXXXXXX"]
    message        = "This Mac is locked. Please call IT."
    phone_number   = "+1 555 0100"
    pin            = var.lock_pin
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `management_ids` (List of String) Jamf Pro Management IDs of the devices to target. These are the `id` values reported by the `jamfplatform_devices`/`jamfplatform_device` data sources. The action commands all listed devices in a single request. Set this and/or `serial_numbers`.
- `message` (String) Message shown on the Lock Screen.
- `phone_number` (String) Phone number shown on the Lock Screen.
- `pin` (String) Six-character PIN that unlocks a computer afterwards. Mobile devices ignore it. Use six digits, which is what macOS expects. This value appears in Terraform plan output, so supply it from a variable or secret store rather than committing it.
- `serial_numbers` (List of String) Serial numbers of the devices to target (case-sensitive). Each is looked up to find its Management ID before the command is sent, so `management_ids` avoids that lookup. Set this and/or `management_ids`.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `invoke` (String) How long the action may run before it is cancelled, as a duration such as `30s` or `10m`. Defaults to 5 minutes.
